Fganon.notes: Phantom Ganon is fought three times and params & 0xF picks which tuning he gets. Variant 0 (sea room 1 layer 1, params 0xE02A6400, and GanonM/GanonC listed below): 30 HP, staggers every 10 damage. Variant 1 (GanonJ maze, params 0xFFFFFF01): 100 HP nominally but one Master Sword hit forces health to 0 - these are the maze phantoms that point at the correct door. Variant 2 (GanonM, params 0xFF006402): 100 HP and ONLY a Light Arrow kills him; that is the tennis fight. NOTE the placement data: GanonM contains the variant-2 fight, GanonJ contains seven variant-1 maze phantoms, GanonC contains six more (five variant 1 plus one variant 2) parked at z = -17000..-24000, which look like unused/dev copies. Only the Master Sword damages him at all (d_a_fganon.cpp:1483-1487) - the same check gates returning the energy ball, so the tennis rally is Master-Sword-only too. FIGHT SHAPE: he flies, so there is no walk/run; he hovers 400 above and 1500 behind Link and closes at speedF 30. Two attacks: (a) the spin sword sweep, where he teleports 270 units behind Link and swings a r200 Atp 8 sphere, and (b) the energy ball - 40-frame charge, thrown at 45 units/frame, which Link must swat back with the Master Sword (or a bottle swing, line 2185). Each exchange speeds the ball up by 2. He gives up the rally after roughly 7 returns and takes the hit. In variant 2 the finishing blow must be a Light Arrow into the body cylinder. flinch_frames = the 150-frame knocked-down window (l_HIO.m48), which is when he is open, not a hit-stun. attack_frames/hit_frame are null because the KAITEN1 BCK length is not in the decomp and no BCK files were extracted into the rip for Fganon.arc (only bdlm models). Sub-actors: MANT (cape), FGMAHOU x8 (the magic orbs he summons, spawned by mahou_set at 570-577), PGSW (sword model), BOKO Type_PGANON_SWORD_e (the sword item dropped after the variant-2 fight). Every function in d_a_fganon.cpp is fully matched - there are no /* Nonmatching */ stubs in this file.

Bgn.notes: Phase 1 is the giant marionette hanging from strings. It has 3 HP and the ONLY thing that damages it is a Light Arrow into the glowing orb at the tail tip (core sphere, r150 at runtime). Everything else - head, pelvis, both arms, both legs, the whole tail - is a chain of r50 spheres that deal Atp 4 on contact and can be struck for sound but not damage. The body is animated entirely in code (part_control_0 / part_control_0Z / part_control_2 / shape_calc), so there is no walk or run animation to map: the only BCK this actor plays is bgn_head1 for the head. Consequently radius/height are per-part rather than a body capsule, and walk/run/gravity/attack_frames are null because the actor genuinely does not have them. hover = l_HIO.m04C = 950, the height of the string anchor above the body, which is the closest thing to a hover value. Keese (KI actors) are spawned continuously and the count rises as its HP drops: 3, then 4, then 5. THIS IS ONE FIGHT IN THREE ACTOR FILES: daBgn_Create spawns BGN2 and BGN3 immediately and parks whichever is not active at y = 30000; m02B5 (0/1/2) is the phase selector and each actor checks it. Only Bgn owns the defeat: it sets dSv_event_flag_c::UNK_3F10 and warps to GanonK spawn 4, which is why boss:true is on this entry and false on Bgn2/Bgn3. d_a_bgn.cpp has no /* Nonmatching */ stubs. attack_frames/hit_frame are null - no BCK lengths are available (Bgn.arc was extracted into the rip as models only, no BCK files).

Bgn2.notes: Phase 2 is the huge spidery 'king crab' body. Not placed in any stage - daBgn_Create spawns it (d_a_bgn.cpp:3681) and it stays parked at y 30000 until bgn->m02B5 == 1. Same 3 HP, same rule: only a Light Arrow into the tail-tip orb (r210 at runtime) counts. Its two moves are a body-slam - climb to y 3000, hang, then drop and crush - and a leap (speed.y 250, gravity -8, forward 50) that flings it across the arena; the tail orb is exposed while it is airborne. Every timing scales with remaining HP: it hangs 60/50/40 frames and spins 1500/2600/3800 s16 after landing as it gets more desperate. Keese keep raining in, up to 10. flinch_frames = the 600-frame mahi (paralysis) state, which is the long opening after it is hit, not a small hit-stun. gravity -2 is the value applied by plesattack/pos_move; the leap uses -8 instead. turn_s16 is null: it does not steer, it snaps current.angle.y straight at Link each frame (line 377). boss:false because this actor never writes the defeat flag - Bgn does. Bgn3.notes: Phase 3 is the long snake ('fast worm'), a chain of 9 segments; only segment 8, the tail tip, takes a Light Arrow, and it takes 3. Not placed in any stage - spawned by Bgn (d_a_bgn.cpp:3682) and dormant until bgn->m02B5 == 2. It never stops flying: it circles the tower at 50 units/frame, speeding up to 60 and then 80 as it loses HP, and its turn rate tightens from 800 to 1000 to 1200 s16 per frame at the same time - so it gets both faster and twitchier. Striking its face stuns it for 10 to 250 frames depending on what you hit it with, and it will chase All-Purpose Bait (ESA) at double turn rate if any is thrown, which is the intended way to hold it still. radius 100 is the per-segment sphere (scale * 100); the face is a separate r150 sphere and the body a r200 one, so a single radius does not really describe it. hover is null - it has no target altitude, it just flies and falls at -5/frame. turn_s16 = 800 is the 3-HP circling rate. flinch_frames = m0FDB4 = 20 in the code but the visible stun is the m26..m30 table above; I put 10 (the weakest entry, m26) and listed the whole table in sources rather than pick one. attack_frames/hit_frame/clips are null for the same reason as phase 1: the body is animated in code and only bgn_head1 is played. d_a_bgn3.cpp has no /* Nonmatching */ stubs. boss:false - Bgn writes the defeat flag.

Gnd.notes: Ganondorf's actor is Gnd (confirmed from GTower's placements and d_stage.cpp:1194). d_a_gnd.cpp is essentially unstarted: 37 of its 38 functions are /* Nonmatching */ stubs, so hp, speeds, turn rates, timers, attack windows, knockback and the HIO table are ALL unknown and are left null. What IS readable is the collision set, and it describes the fight exactly: a body cylinder (r100 h100) that only responds to AT_TYPE_SWORD; a r15 head sphere, also sword-only, which is the pinpoint target for the final stab; a r100 chest sphere whose only accepted attack types are NORMAL_ARROW and LIGHT_ARROW and which carries the Shield flag; and a r70 Atp 4 weapon sphere for his two blades, which also carries the Shield flag so his swords can be met and parried rather than only dodged. WHAT THE FIGHT NEEDS: the Master Sword (the body and head are AT_TYPE_SWORD only, and d_a_fganon.cpp:1483 shows how that check is written elsewhere), the Mirror Shield, and Zelda. d_a_arrow.cpp:318-345 is the load-bearing piece the boss file is missing: while Link Z-targets Ganondorf, an arrow reflected off the shield is auto-aimed at his chest at y = 130 and sets his param to 0x23 - that is the stun, and it comes from Zelda's Light Arrows, not from Link's bow. The stub names confirm the rest of the shape: move0, attack0/1/2, attackPZ (an attack aimed at the Princess), attack_last, defence0, damage/damage_check, finish, plus mNextParryOpeningType in the class - a parry duel with a scripted finish. clips are marked LOW confidence on purpose: every BCK name listed is real and read out of Gnd.arc's generated header, but WHICH state plays WHICH one cannot be verified because anm_init and all callers are stubs. 'kuzuku' (collapse) as the death clip and 'furimuku' (turn around) as the notice clip are name-based guesses. 'ganon' and 'combo_ganon' are almost certainly the ending transformation, and bougyo1-7 are guards, counterl/counterr the parries.
